## Problem and result / 문제·변경 결과

Link the issue and describe the concrete input and resulting behavior.

## Scope / 범위

What changed? Note intentional limits and any related pending PR.

## Validation / 검증

List commands and results actually run, including the tested Python version.
For a runtime bug, show the failing baseline and passing fix.
For a feature, state the previous behavior and verify the proposed behavior.
For a documentation-only change, list relevant links or commands checked.

## Remaining work / 남은 작업

Describe anything still needed before review is complete.
